history_summary: Add two species-reference GTDB correspondences to the Glutamicibacter aquaculture consortium
history_details: The selected Glutamicibacter arilaitensis and Glutamicibacter nicotianae species-ID routes report reference populations 9/fraction 1.0 and 12/fraction 1.0. These populations do not establish the genomes of the source strains NFB2-4 and CYN-C5. Preserve source aliases, the historical crosswalk-unavailability note, nitrogen-removal endpoints and existing environmental and interaction limitations. Only the two GTDB blocks/statuses and two native inline events change. Full scientific review, source-snippet coverage and corpus QC remain separate.
